summary: Describes a change to AS112 deployment that uses DNS DNAME records. With it, zones can be redirected to AS112 servers and removed again without every AS112 operator having to edit their own server configuration.

eli5.summary: Instead of every helper desk updating its own list, one forwarding sign at the main desk says to send these questions to the helper desk. Changing the sign is easy.

questions: how to add zone to as112
